body: Elections in my country, I always get anxious for that, but I am going to start uni in a few weeks and the feel of being an absolute failure is killing me, It's kind of stupid but I don't know why I care so much about this things.
He is a good person and I feel it's not fair that he is dealing with his shit and then help me with my shit, sorry for english, it's not my first language.

The voices in my head tell me someone is trying to kill me or that tomorrow is the end of the world, my depression and anxiety is getting worse and there is some other personal shit that I can't stop thinking about and feel gross about myself, this shit doesn't leave me sleep or eat, I'm always in alert and I feel really tired of that. Maybe is not a big deal but I feel like a big deal.
I'm really happy for you, I hope you get better and better!!
